answer_1.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of COPE with experiments in five different personalized open‑ended text generation tasks from Language Model Personalization (LaMP) and LongLaMP benchmarks.
answer_1.outputs: personalized generated text (e.g., headlines, titles, abstracts, reviews, Reddit posts)

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we mainly report ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L scores across all tasks, which serve as standard evaluation metrics to measure the content relevance and structural similarity between the generated and ground‑truth texts.
